title: Write to us
summary: Header X as a text sheet: lands on the founder's letter line ('If you write to us, a person answers.'), answers who reads it and how fast in the facts ledger, and names the other door once, quietly, so the memo below can be the page's object.

reference.site: Approved interior header X (round 3, 'Specimen sheet'; its title block retired) and the homepage letter/S, whose line this header lands on
reference.borrowed: Header X's grammar unchanged: label + mono breadcrumb, two-voice h1, 48×2 rule, lede cols 1–6, three-row facts ledger cols 9–12 bottom-aligned with the lede.
reference.kelwin: Text sheet (TX): no band, no drawing, no red beyond the label square and the rule. The facts answer the visitor's first questions (who reads it, how fast) and carry the quiet door to the audit.

story: The landing: the homepage letter promised 'If you write to us, a person answers.' The h1 keeps that promise in its own words, the lede says what the channel is for and that nothing enters a CRM or a sequence, the facts say who reads it and when, and the audit is offered once, quietly, for the visitor who arrived at the wrong door.
copy: h1 [N, from the letter's approved line] “Write to us. / A person answers.”
lede [N] “Questions, a document, press, the Lab — or you’re not sure yet what you need. This is the channel. It goes to one inbox, a person reads it, and nothing you send enters a CRM or a sequence.”
facts: Read by · The founder (FC, §7 Q1)
facts: Reply · Within two working days [K] (FC, §7 Q3)
facts: Ready to diagnose? · The System Audit ↗ [N]
metadata title [R] “Talk to the team — Kelwin”; description [K]
phone: ≤1023: the kit composes it — the nav menu gives way to production's menu button, the h1 takes the full width, the facts ledger drops under the lede (cols 1–9). ≤767: h1 40px and wraps, lede 17px, facts full width under the lede; the page goes straight into the memo with no band to recompose.
motion: entrance: the kit's head choreography — label fades, the h1 rises line by line, the rule draws, the lede and the facts ledger rise. No band, so no morph: the page's one body moment is the memo's hairlines drawing.
ambient: none. interaction: hover on the nav, the facts ledger's quiet door.
on the live site: plays once on load; the nav bar is at rest (production's bar). Reduced motion: final state at once.
notes: No band by design (STORY-INTERIOR §4.5, §5 TX): the form is this page's object. Resources is lit in the nav because /contact is the Resources plate's R·03 ('Talk to the team').
